items.title: ponytail
items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
items.summary: Ponytail is a tool that makes AI code more efficient by minimizing unnecessary code. It embodies the philosophy that the best code is the code you never write. It's inspired by the "lazy senior dev" approach.

items.title: omnigent
items.description: A meta-harness for all your AI agents.  Omnigent provides a common layer over Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and the agents you write yourself: swap or combine harnesses without rewriting, keep them in check with policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time on the same live session, from any device.
items.summary: Omnigent is a meta-harness for managing and combining AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. It allows seamless integration and collaboration without rewriting. It supports real-time collaboration across devices.

items.summary: To enable full Apple Intelligence on a mainland China Mac, use the RegionSpoof script to modify the device region code. This allows access to full Apple features including local and cloud-based AI services. Ensure you follow the installation instructions carefully.

items.title: coreai-models
items.description: Model export recipes, Python primitives, and Swift runtime utilities for on-device AI
items.summary: Core AI Models provides tools for exporting models, Python primitives, and Swift utilities for on-device AI. It supports building AI applications directly on Apple devices. The main components include model export recipes and runtime utilities.

items.title: effective-html
items.description: Agent skill for elegant and simple html plans, architecture diagrams, or whatever else you can think of.
items.summary: Effective-HTML is a skill for creating elegant, simple HTML plans and architecture diagrams. It includes sub-skills for general pages, full-screen diagrams, and plan pages. Available on GitHub for easy integration.

items.summary: Renwei-writing is an AI tool designed to edit text while preserving the author's unique voice and presence. It focuses on maintaining the original author's intent and personality. It is open source.

items.title: text-humanizer
items.description: Advanced open-source AI humanizer designed to make AI-generated text undetectable by Turnitin, GPTZero, and other AI detection services.
items.summary: AI humanizers aim to make AI-generated text appear more human, but effectiveness varies. Some tools claim to bypass detection by AI detection services. Verify results as detection methods evolve.

items.title: fanbox

items.summary: Vibe Coding cockpit features files on the left, terminal on the right, and central view for tracking changes. It integrates local file browsing, code preview, and terminal in one window. It aims to reduce context switching for developers.

The Ralph Loop exemplifies this in practice for enterprise software delivery.
